source: Schreiber and Moissenet (2019), figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.7734767.v8, archive file 22295019, CC BY 4.0
design: Retrospective prediction between stored bins from barefoot overground C2 walking at 0.4 to 0.8 m/s. Published files were event-cropped, marker gaps were filled, all signals were filtered in both time directions, and EMG was centered across the recording. Every new input operation is restricted to stored history. This cannot establish prospective timing or a live muscle-to-force pathway.
split: Sort the 50 original numeric participant folders by ID. First 30 train, next 10 assess after the entire fit seal, last 10 remain unopened. Use the lowest three existing C2 numeric repeats per folder, without replacement. Only 2014001_C2_01 is a designated source-development case; it is retained in training. Manifest SHA256 e0ccb1ae4a37c12d47c5e63ce3c9372efa212fa475275eef4dc40c2143aeda32.
target: Vertical force recorded by the two walkway plates, in newtons. Average the upward lab-coordinate components over the 15 analog samples in point-frame block i+10, and sum both plates. For the qualified flat, aligned setup this equals mean(-Fz1-Fz2). No threshold or body-mass normalization added. A foot may be elsewhere on the walkway. No per-foot assignment. Reject unsupported plate calibration/orientation/units; require finite bilateral platform targets. Exclude independently documented invalid underlying recordings. Omitted or all-missing force circuits are never replaced with zero. If a whole exported circuit is identically zero and there is no independent confirmation distinguishing an available circuit from a coded missing one, withhold that trial and report why. An unavailable clean single-foot contact annotation alone does not invalidate an otherwise observed plate waveform.
features: Use 8 consecutive 30-ms tokens from stored frames i-23 through i. Each token ends at its third point frame, with XYZ in metres relative to the midpoint of the two platform centres for L_FCC,L_FM2,R_FCC,R_FM2,L_IAS,R_IAS, followed by six binary valid-marker flags. Preserve C3D residual and finite-coordinate validity. Right-sided EMG token is RMS in microvolts over all 45 corresponding analog samples, in order tibialis_anterior,soleus,gastrocnemius_medialis,vastus_medialis,rectus_femoris,semitendinosus,gluteus_maximus,gluteus_medius, followed by eight per-channel valid flags. Missing samples invalidate that token/channel. A source-documented unavailable channel is masked. Whole-trial zero EMG quality may be reported but is not used to create earlier availability flags. Missing numeric features are imputed with training-only means, then standardized and clipped to [-8,8]. Flags remain 0/1. No file index, person ID, gait event, trial length/fraction, force history or target travels into primary predictors.
time: Use zero-based i = 23,26,29,... with i+10 inside the recording. Each anchor is determined from the fixed stride and recorded boundaries. The latest input and target analog block centers differ by 100 ms on the nominal 1500 Hz clock. The final physical input sample precedes the first target sample by 136/1500 s = 90.67 ms on that clock. No claim of calibrated hardware latency. The complete 240 ms electrical support plus 100 ms bin-center offset pertains only to the exported representation.
models: Fit three separate temporal Transformers once, using markers only (24 columns), EMG only (16 columns), or both (40 columns). Each uses an affine input embedding width 24, learned 8-by-24 positional table, single pre-normalized three-head scaled dot-product self-attention, residual, second LayerNorm, affine 24->48, ReLU, affine 48->24, residual, final-token LayerNorm and scalar linear readout. All tokens predate the target; full attention within the history. Fixed seed 7693 for each fit, no dropout; AdamW lr .002 weight decay .01, MSE on Newton targets divided by 500, 400 updates of 128 histories sampled with replacement with equal expected participant, trial then anchor weight. No outcome-based selection. Clip all physical predictions below zero at inference. No validation search.
comparisons: Fit matching flattened normalized linear ridge for all three inputs, weighted equally by participant/trial then anchor; intercept unpenalized, penalty .01 against the weighted mean square in 500-N units. Strong nonlinear kinematic baseline is Gaussian landmark ridge on all flattened normalized marker tokens with 256 weighted-sampled training centres (seed 7694); squared-distance bandwidth is median nonzero between-centre squared distance, kernel exp(-d2/bandwidth), ridge penalty .0001 with intercept. Additional controls: weighted train mean, zero, and privileged persistence of current stored two-plate load. The wrong-trial control reuses sealed combined model weights: cyclic next repeat from the same person, select the donor anchor at or before the recipient's elapsed anchor with least mean squared train-standardized difference in jointly observed last-token marker XYZ, earliest tie. Without a donor or comparable pose omit that paired control window and give counts. This is an offline same-person wrong-repeat control and proximity need not perfectly match gait phase.
evaluation: Primary measure is mean absolute error N, averaged within trial then within participant then across people. Whole-trial software windows with finite ground truth are the primary denominator, independently of contact, phase and size. Give separate RMSE (square-root of nested mean squared error), signed bias, zero/nonzero target error summaries and counts for interpretation. Report participant-paired mean differences and 95% percentile intervals across 10000 whole-person paired bootstrap samples, seed 7695. No window-level inferential power. For an incremental EMG claim, combined Transformer must reduce MAE by at least 5% relative to EACH of marker-only Transformer, nonlinear marker ridge, and same-person wrong-repeat EMG on paired support, with upper endpoint of each 95% difference interval strictly below 0 N, and coverage of at least 8 people. Report every contrast either way. Identity of optimal methods must not trigger retraining or switching. External dataset, other speeds, raw unfiltered channels, even hardware lag, limb-specific target, and independent site transfer are untested.
